newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Over 30 die, thousands flee Philippine fighting.
newsitem.headline: Over 30 die, thousands flee Philippine fighting.

text.p: Over 30 people have died and 10,000 villagers have fled their homes in week-long fighting between soldiers and Moslem rebels in the southern Philippines, the military said on Tuesday.

"The operation will continue and I believe casualties will increase as fighting goes on," southern commander General Romeo Padiernos said as hundreds of soldiers, backed by helicopter gunships, chased about 200 guerrillas in Maguindanao province.

Clashes began on Monday last week after the rebels belonging to the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) seized the project site of the Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp in Sultan-sa-Barongis town.
The dead included 30 guerrillas and three soldiers, Padiernos told reporters.
About 30,000 villagers have fled to government evacuation centres to avoid being caught in the crossfire, officials said.

Padierno said the fighting should not affect peace talks between the government and the MILF because the military was pursuing MILF factions engaged in kidnap-for-ransom activities in the Maguindanao area.
Nearly 50 people, mostly businessmen, have been kidnapped in Maguindanao since January.
Army spokesman Captain Noel Detoyato dismissed a MILF report that the guerrillas had killed 40 soldiers and sunk two naval boats moving up the Rio Grande river near rebel positions.
"We would have run out of coffins by now," he said.
